name: SMS Skylands Original Mapchip Pack
generation_note: Created as new original pixel art with a Sega Master System-style 64-color palette. No pixels were cut from the reference image.

target_spec.hardware_palette_model: 64 visible colors approximated by RGB channels 0/85/170/255
target_spec.mapchip_composition: Each 16x16 map chip is composed of four 8x8 patterns.
target_spec.transparent_index: palette index 0 is transparent for sprites and overlay mapchips
